_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_replace_counters.py. t_rc_scales is High Score's and Hardened Scales' addend; t_rc_season is Doubling Season's multiplier over every counter kind; t_rc_charge doubles charge counters only, so the kind filter can be shown to bite; t_rc_bear is a plain creature to put counters on and t_rc_rock a noncreature artifact that the 'creature you control' filter must miss.

cards.name: Test Hardened Scales
cards.oracle_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.

abilities.text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.

cards.name: Test Doubling Season
cards.oracle_text: If one or more counters would be put on a permanent you control, twice that many of those counters are put on it instead.

abilities.text: If one or more counters would be put on a permanent you control, twice that many of those counters are put on it instead.

cards.name: Test Charge Doubler
cards.oracle_text: If one or more charge counters would be put on a permanent you control, twice that many charge counters are put on it instead.

abilities.text: If one or more charge counters would be put on a permanent you control, twice that many charge counters are put on it instead.
